_doc: Hand-written specification of the 13 element roles Quoro knows. 'specs' describe, per role, which element feature combinations belong to it; src/dataset.js samples labelled training examples from them (the training set is generated, nothing is downloaded). Numeric ranges are closed [lo, hi]; open bounds are written with a 1e-7 offset. Unlisted booleans default to false for 'line' and 'text', and to random for 'visible'.

title.description: Slide headline: a title or centred-title placeholder holding text.

subtitle.description: Secondary headline under a title (subtitle placeholder with text).

body.description: Main text placeholder (bullets / paragraphs) with no box of its own.

text.description: Free text box without a box, fill or outline, not tied to a placeholder.

label.description: Text inside a visible shape: a card, badge, button or callout.

backdropLabel.description: Text on a visible shape that covers most of the slide (a full-bleed panel).

shape.description: Decorative or illustrative shape without text: circles, icons built from shapes, blocks.

rule.description: Line, connector, arrow or very thin bar used as a divider or a link between items.

picture.description: Photograph, logo, screenshot or other image that does not fill the slide.

backdrop.description: Full-bleed background picture or shape behind everything else.

chart.description: Bar, line, area, pie or scatter chart.

footer.description: Date, footer text or slide number placeholder.
